Theorem
Source: topping:page-0081 ↗ topping-ch7-pointed-cheeger-gromov-convergence ↗ topping-ch7-pointed-convergence-example ↗ topping-ch7-compact-limit-possible 1. ch7:1.3\group compactness-manifolds

Let $(\M _i,g_i,p_i)$ be complete, smooth, pointed Riemannian manifolds of a common dimension $n$. If (7.1.1) and (7.1.2) hold, then some subsequence converges smoothly in the pointed sense to a complete, smooth, pointed Riemannian manifold $(\M ,g,p)$ of dimension $n$.
